authorRepairs.before: In the fifty-sixth year he returned to court, repeatedly memorialized asking to be dismissed, and the emperor temporarily stopped this because Grand Secretary Wang Yan was already on leave.
authorRepairs.after: In the fifty-sixth year he returned to court, repeatedly memorialized asking to be dismissed, and the emperor temporarily stopped this because Grand Secretary Wang Shan was already on leave.
authorRepairs.reason: Chinese 王掞 is Wang Shan, not Wang Yan (王衍).

authorRepairs.before: In the fifty-sixth year he returned to court and repeatedly asked to be dismissed, but the emperor held off because Grand Secretary Wang Yan was already away on leave.
authorRepairs.after: In the fifty-sixth year he returned to court and repeatedly asked to be dismissed, but the emperor held off because Grand Secretary Wang Shan was already away on leave.
authorRepairs.reason: Chinese 王掞 is Wang Shan, not Wang Yan (王衍).

authorRepairs.before: Xiangfu, for a child still in arms, yet fully mourned to receive guests;
authorRepairs.after: Yifu, for a child still in arms, yet fully mourned to receive guests;
authorRepairs.reason: 夷甫 is Yifu, not Xiangfu. Courtesy identification as Wang Yan remains in the idiomatic field.

authorRepairs.before: The Emperor said: "Do not, like Wang Yifu mistaking Shi Le, wrongly destroy a loyal man."
authorRepairs.after: The Emperor said: "Do not, like Wang Yifu recognizing Shi Le, wrongly destroy a loyal man."
